title: Galidor - Defenders of the Outer Dimension (USA) (En,Fr,De,Es,It,Nl,Sv,Da)

fields.name: header_magic
fields.evidence: FUN_080237e0 auStack_10[0]=0x28 (decompiled.c:3622); FUN_08023a24 cStack_18 == '(' i.e. 0x28 (line 3790). Both .sav files: logical byte 0 = 0x28 after reversing each 8-byte raw block.

fields.name: header_checksum_be
fields.evidence: FUN_08023928 lines 3713-3715; FUN_08023a24 lines 3791-3794 CONCAT11(uStack_17,uStack_16). Python: sum(logical[3:512])&0xFFFF equals stored on both files (0x1462, 0x0C6C). PACKET probe at raw offset 0x5 = logical byte 2 (checksum low) reverted to blank, corroborating.
